action_taken: Cases of loose motion and stomach pain were reported from Village Maluguru, Sub-District Hindupur, District Sri Sathya Sai. District RRT investigated the outbreak. The affected age group was 11-19 years. Cases had consumed lunch consisting of chicken and other food items at the school hostel. All cases were treated symptomatically. Community awareness and health education given by the peripheral team on safe drinking water and food habits, hygiene and sanitation.

The affected age group was 9 months -8 years. 2 serum samples collected, tested positive for Measles (IgM ELISA). Community awareness and health education given by the peripheral team on isolation of cases and vaccination, hygiene and sanitation.

Cases of fever, headache, vomiting and loose motion were reported from Village and Sub-District Dhakuakhana (Pt-I), District Lakhimpur. District RRT investigated the outbreak. The affected age group was 9-72 years. The cases developed symptoms after consumption of rice and pork meat with banana flower at a hotel at Matmora Akuaria village. 6 rectal swab specimens were collected at Dhakuakhana SDCH and sent to District Public health Laboratory (DPHL), IDSP, Lakhimpur for culture and sensitivity test. Results showed normal growth of E. Coli after 48 hours of aerobic incubation in all 6 samples. Community awareness and health education given by the peripheral team on safe drinking water and food habits, hygiene and sanitation.

Cases of fever, abdominal discomfort and dark coloured urine were reported from Village Shaho Bigha, Sub-District Ghoshi, District Jehanabad. District RRT investigated the outbreak. The affected age group was 2 months-26 years. Active house-to-house surveillance was conducted. 5 blood samples were tested at PMCH, Patna.

Cases of abdominal pain and loose motion were reported from Village Hathaud, Sub-District Marri Bangla Dewri, District Balod. District and Block RRT investigated the outbreak. Both children and adults were affected. A door-to-door survey and health camp was organized in the village. 3 stool samples were sent to DH Raipur and showed no positive findings on culture. The PHE department tested 7 water samples and all were safe for drinking. Distribution of ORS packets, zinc tablets and chlorine tablets was done. Community awareness and health education given by the peripheral team on safe drinking water and food habits, hygiene and sanitation.

Cases of fever were reported from Village Pachadumar, Sub-District Ketar, District Garhwa. District RRT investigated the outbreak. The affected age group was 5-70 years. All 8 cases were from the same family. 6 blood samples tested negative for Malaria by Microscopy Peripheral Blood Smear (MP). 2 males aged 7 and 10 years died on 22.08.26 due to high fever. House- to-house survey was done. Community awareness and health education given by the peripheral team on vector control measures, safe drinking water and food habits, hygiene and sanitation.

A 1-year-old male child from Khenjdiya Faliya, Village Munjal, Block Thandla, District Jhabua, was admitted to PICU, DH Jhabua, on 14.08.2026 with symptoms of AES. The child was referred to SSG Hospital, Vadodara, Gujarat, on 15.08.2026 due to lack of improvement. A serum sample tested negative for Chandipura virus by RT- PCR from Gujarat Biotechnology Research Centre Gandhinagar (Gujarat) Lab on 20.08.2026. Serum and CSF samples reported positive for CHPV IgM by ELISA on 25.08.2026 from ICMR NIV Pune. The child died on 22.08.2026 at SSG Hospital, Vadodara. A village-level survey was conducted; no new AES cases were reported. Community awareness and health education given by the peripheral team on vector control measures, safe drinking water and food habits, hygiene and sanitation.

Cases of fever, headache, bodyache, sore throat and cough were reported from Tanhril locality, Village Tanhril, Sub-District Tlangnuam, District Aizawl. District RRT investigated the outbreak. The affected age group was 1 month-55 years. A health camp and environment study were conducted. Blood samples of 57 patients were collected. The testing was done on site using RDT. 2 cases of scrub typhus and 1 of dengue were detected by RDT. Symptomatic treatments were given including supplementary vitamins. Community awareness and health education given by the peripheral team on safe drinking water and food habits, hygiene and sanitation.
